description: This Java source file defines an Android activity 'CubeMapActivity' that demonstrates the use of the OpenGL ES 1.x extension for cube mapping (OES_texture_cube_map). It includes rendering logic, extension support checks, cube map texture loading, and a custom grid class for rendering a torus grid with OpenGL buffers.

classes.name: CubeMapActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating cube mapping in OpenGL ES with support for extension detection and texture setup.

classes.name: CubeMapActivity$Renderer
classes.description: Inner class implementing GLSurfaceView.Renderer to handle rendering frames, creating textures, and managing OpenGL context support checks.

classes.name: Grid
classes.description: Internal class representing a grid of vertices and indices, with support for VBO creation and rendering, used to generate torus geometry.

methods.name: checkGLError
methods.description: Utility method to check for OpenGL errors and throw an exception if any are found.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView, sets its renderer, and attaches it to the activity.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Overrides activity's onResume to resume the GLSurfaceView rendering.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Overrides activity's onPause to pause the GLSurfaceView rendering.

methods.name: generateCubeMap
methods.description: Loads six bitmap textures and uploads them as a cube map texture to OpenGL.

methods.name: generateTorusGrid
methods.description: Creates a 'Grid' object representing a torus shape with vertex normals, ready for rendering.

methods.name: checkIfContextSupportsCubeMap
methods.description: Checks if the current GL context supports the GL_OES_texture_cube_map extension.

methods.name: checkIfContextSupportsExtension
methods.description: Checks if a given extension string is available in the current GL context.
